subject: Final invoice routing and VAT residency check — multi-tranche acceptance
messages:
From: Elena Marquez <elena.marquez@atlashealth.eu>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlashealth.eu, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Mar 2028 17:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Final invoice & VAT handling for renewal (PO attached)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the renewal quote — we have internal approval to proceed but need final invoicing details before procurement will release the PO. Attached is our PO (Atlas_PO_78921.pdf). A couple of clarifying questions:

- Can Redwood issue the final invoice split across two tranches (60% now, 40% on go-live) and still consolidate a single billing reference? Our finance team prefers staged invoices to match budget lines.
- For VAT: we are EU-registered and typically use reverse-charge but procurement needs confirmation you can accept a VAT residency certificate and mark the invoice accordingly (no VAT charged).
- If you need any additional documentation from our tax team, tell me what’s required.

We can sign the DocuSign once redlines are resolved — I attached the PO for reference.

Best,
Elena
Procurement Lead | Atlas Health
[Attachment: Atlas_PO_78921.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Marquez <elena.marquez@atlashealth.eu>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Mar 2028 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final invoice & VAT handling for renewal (PO attached)

Hi Elena — thanks for the PO and the clear questions. Short answers up front: yes, we can issue tranche invoices and we can accommodate EU reverse-charge provided we receive a valid VAT residency/certificate and the PO references the customer tax ID.

Option summary (recommended):
1) Issue two invoices (60% / 40%) referencing the single subscription ID and PO number — both invoices will have the same invoice reference prefix so your systems can reconcile easily.
2) If Atlas prefers a single invoice with payment terms that allow staged payments, we can do that too (less ideal for your AR processes).
3) For EU VAT reverse-charge: please provide a VAT registration document (certificate or tax ID) and confirm the billing address — we will include the reverse-charge note and zero-rate VAT on the invoice.

Monica — can you confirm payment routing (wire vs SEPA vs SWIFT) and whether finance needs separate remittance advice per tranche? I’m attaching a quick invoice split template (Proposed_Invoice_Split.xlsx) — feel free to edit.

Elena — once we have the VAT doc + PO with tax ID noted, we’ll prepare the tranche invoices and send a DocuSign for the final order form redline (I’ve copied Laura for any contract items).

Thanks,
Karthik
Head, Renewals — Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0182]
[Attachment: Proposed_Invoice_Split.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 12KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Elena Marquez <elena.marquez@atlashealth.eu>
Date: Mon, 20 Mar 2028 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Final invoice & VAT handling for renewal (PO attached)

Karthik / Laura / Elena — finance ops here. A few operational points so we don’t block the PO: 

- Payment routing: For EU customers we prefer SEPA when possible. If Atlas will send SWIFT, please include IBAN + BIC and we’ll note beneficiary references.
- Separate remittance: We can issue separate invoices per tranche and will provide individual remittance advices. That said, please ensure each tranche invoice includes the master PO number so your AP can automatically reconcile.
- VAT residency: a VAT certificate or government tax ID string is sufficient. We will apply reverse-charge and add the standard EU reverse-charge narrative on both tranche invoices.

Action for Atlas: please add your tax ID to the PO (procurement can append) and upload the VAT cert (if available). Once we receive that, we’ll draft tranche invoices and email DocuSign for the order form. 

Attaching a redline-friendly DocuSign export I used for a similar customer — helps speed signature.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: DocuSign_Agreement_Redline.pdf (application/pdf, 24KB)]

Thanks Monica — procurement has added our tax ID (EU-TAX-44-99123) to the PO and I’ve asked the tax team to attach the VAT certificate in the next hour.

We plan to approve the 60/40 split and pay via SEPA for both tranches. Confirmation on scheduling: will Redwood issue the first tranche invoice on signature and the second on go-live? If so, please indicate expected invoice dates so we can align internal approvals.

Also: any WHT implications we should be aware of from Redwood’s side (we are cross-border EU -> US)?

Elena

Subject: Re: Final invoice & VAT handling for renewal (PO attached)

Elena / team — great, and thanks for the quick turnaround on the tax ID. Finalizing next steps here: 

Action items (Redwood):
- Monica to issue tranche invoices: first invoice on signature (expected 2028-03-21), second invoice on go-live (expected 2028-05-01). Both will carry the master PO number and the same invoice reference prefix.
- Finance will mark both invoices with EU reverse-charge language once we receive the VAT certificate.
- Laura to confirm contract redline items; any material changes will be surfaced before DocuSign.

Action items (Atlas):
- Upload VAT certificate to procurement and confirm SEPA bank details will be used for both payments.
- Confirm go-live date so Redwood can target the second invoice date (suggested: 2028-05-01).

WHT note: Redwood does not typically withhold WHT on SaaS subscriptions for EU -> US flows; if Atlas has mandatory withholding we can add the gross-up language to the SOW but we’ll need the WHT certificate from your tax authority at payment time.

I’ll open the DocuSign in the next hour with the RFO redline attached and route to Elena for signature. Thanks all — we’ll move to billing draft as soon as VAT cert is uploaded.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
